wire.errors.agent_avatar.empty_body.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.empty_body.note: Refusal when the PUT request carrying the picture has an empty body. Mostly seen by developers/agents calling the API.

wire.errors.agent_avatar.imaging_unavail.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.imaging_unavail.note: Refusal when this install lacks the Pillow image library (the 'images' optional extra). 'images' is a literal package extra name; keep it untranslated.

wire.errors.agent_avatar.not_found.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.not_found.note: 404 answer when an agent's profile picture is requested but none is set.

wire.errors.agent_avatar.too_large.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.too_large.note: Refusal when an uploaded agent profile picture file exceeds the input cap. {limit_mib} is an integer number of mebibytes (10); render with the locale's MB abbreviation.

wire.errors.agent_avatar.too_many_pixels.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.too_many_pixels.note: Refusal when an uploaded agent profile picture decodes to more pixels than allowed. {limit_mp} is an integer (40).

wire.errors.agent_avatar.undecodable.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.undecodable.note: Refusal when an uploaded agent profile picture looks like an image but cannot be decoded (corrupt/truncated).

wire.errors.agent_avatar.unsupported_typ.role: API refusal sentence (desktop/phone show it to the person)
wire.errors.agent_avatar.unsupported_typ.note: Refusal when a picture upload for an agent's profile picture is not a recognised image (sniffed by content, not filename). Product/format names stay as-is.
